title.suggested: Tom Allen's Housekeeper Testifies at Brown Murder Inquest

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported that a coroner's jury held John "Nig" Rodgers responsible for beating William C. Brown to death outside the Ohio saloon. Mrs. Duffy, Tom Allen's housekeeper, was the only witness to the assault.

facts.fact: Mrs. Duffy, Allen's housekeeper, was the only witness at the coroner's inquest to say she saw William C. Brown assaulted outside the Ohio saloon
